Your full name and home address
A public news article

correct_answer.text: Your full name and home address

questions.question_text: Why is privacy important for teens online?

options.text: It helps you get more followers on social media
It protects you from risks like identity theft and stalking
It makes your posts go viral faster
It ensures your phone battery lasts longer

correct_answer.text: It protects you from risks like identity theft and stalking

questions.question_text: What is a safe way to use privacy settings on social media?

options.text: Keep your account public so everyone can see your posts
Set your account to private so only approved followers can view your content
Share your location in every post to connect with friends
Allow strangers to send you direct messages without restrictions

correct_answer.text: Set your account to private so only approved followers can view your content

questions.question_text: Which of the following should you avoid posting online to stay safe?

options.text: A picture of your pet without any location tags
Your home address and school schedule in a public post
A funny meme with no personal information
A group photo where everyone agreed to be shared

correct_answer.text: Your home address and school schedule in a public post

questions.question_text: What is a potential risk of oversharing personal data on social media?

options.text: Your account might get more likes and shares
Strangers could use your info for cyberbullying or scams
Your friends will automatically protect your privacy
Your posts will be deleted by the app automatically

correct_answer.text: Strangers could use your info for cyberbullying or scams
